raw.details:
Event Details

  • Date: 24 October 2026
  • Time: 10:00 AM – 1:30 PM
  • Venue: Main Ground, I.T.S Engineering College, Greater Noida
  • Registration Fee: ₹200/team
  • Prize Pool: ₹10,000
  • Coordinator: Miss Riddhi Chahar

Event Description

Poster Exhibition at TechTrix'26 provides a platform for grassroots innovators to present innovative posters and paintings addressing real-world problems across software and hardware domains. Participants explain their ideas and technical concepts to a jury, demonstrating the relevance and practical application of their work.

Guidelines

Team Size & Eligibility

  • 2 participants per team
  • Open to undergraduate/postgraduate students and eligible participants from colleges/institutions
  • Valid college/institutional ID is mandatory
  • Only registered participants may compete; one participant cannot be registered in two teams for the same event
  • Team composition cannot be changed after the registration deadline without written approval from the Event Coordinator
  • The registered team captain is the official point of contact

Poster Format

  • Recommended Size: A1, portrait orientation
  • Must clearly include: Title, Problem Statement, Methodology, Results, Applications, References
  • Figures, diagrams, and photographs may be used where they support the technical explanation

Presentation Format

  • Each participant/team must explain their poster to the jury
  • The jury may ask technical, application-based, and problem/solution-related questions — participants should be prepared to explain both the technical content and practical relevance of their work

Judging Criteria

Criteria Weightage
Technical Content 25%
Innovation 20%
Depth of Work / Research 20%
Visual Communication 15%
Practical Application 10%
Presentation & Q&A 10%
Total 100%

Note: A visually attractive poster without meaningful technical content will not receive a high technical score. All copied material must be properly referenced.

Disqualification

A team may be disqualified for:

  • Receiving external assistance during the competition
  • Plagiarism or cheating (including uncredited copied material)
  • Misconduct with judges, volunteers, or organisers
  • Misrepresentation of participant identity

The Event Jury/Organizing Committee holds final authority on judging, penalties, disqualification, and interpretation of rules.

NOTE-: Registration Fees are not refundable.
